sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Choose the correct preposition to complete the sentence: The adventurous cat leaped proudly ___ the high garden wall.
In the game of Gilli Danda, what is the 'Gilli' primarily made of?
Identify the correct conjunction: She was feeling very tired, ___ she still finished all her homework.
In the poem 'Vocation', who does the young child see walking in the dark streets at night?
Identify the voice of this sentence: 'The winning goal was scored by the team captain.'
In 'The Decision of the Panchayat', who is considered the ultimate voice of justice in the village?
Choose the correct indirect speech: He said, "I am reading a book."
options: A) He said that he is reading a book.
B) He said that I was reading a book.
C) He said that he was reading a book.
D) He says that he was reading a book.
questions.answer: C) He said that he was reading a book.

questions.question_text: In the chapter 'Glass Bangles', which Indian city is famous for its massive glass bangle industry?
Which of the following words is a synonym for 'courageous'?
Choose the suitable interjection: ___! We have finally won the championship trophy!

sections.section_name: Section B - Short Answer and Grammar Competency

questions.question_text: Based on the chapter 'What a Tank', why was the village tank considered incredibly important to the local people? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The tank was incredibly important because it stored rainwater for the dry months, providing the villagers with an essential water supply for drinking, washing, and farming.

questions.question_text: Change the following sentence into indirect speech: The science teacher said, "The Earth revolves around the Sun." [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The science teacher said that the Earth revolves around the Sun. We do not change the tense of the verb because the statement is a universal truth.

questions.question_text: In the poem 'Vocation', why does the child secretly envy the gardener working outside his house? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The child envies the gardener because he is entirely free to dig the soil, get his clothes dirty, and bake in the hot sun without anyone scolding him.

questions.question_text: Rewrite this sentence changing it from active voice to passive voice: "The skilled craftsman makes beautiful glass bangles." [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Beautiful glass bangles are made by the skilled craftsman. In this passive voice sentence, the focus shifts to the object receiving the action rather than the doer.

questions.question_text: Describe the basic equipment required to play the traditional game mentioned in 'Gilli Danda'. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: To play Gilli Danda, players need two wooden sticks: a longer one called the 'danda' used for striking, and a smaller, oval-shaped piece called the 'gilli'.

questions.question_text: In 'The Decision of the Panchayat', explain why Jumman and Algu temporarily became enemies and how the Panchayat's sense of justice resolved their issue. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: Jumman and Algu became enemies after Algu gave a fair verdict against Jumman in a property dispute. However, when Jumman later became the head Panch in Algu's case, he realized the heavy responsibility of truth, gave a fair decision, and reunited with his friend.

questions.question_text: Describe the difficult and hazardous conditions under which the workers create beautiful items in the chapter 'Glass Bangles'. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: The workers sit in dark, poorly ventilated rooms right next to extremely hot glass furnaces. They work for long hours welding colored glass pieces into beautiful bangles. This continuous exposure to high heat and dim light often damages their eyesight permanently over time.

sections.section_name: Section D - Expression and Applied Composition

questions.question_text: Write a short informal letter to your friend inviting them to your village to play traditional games like Gilli Danda during the summer holidays. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Dear Rahul, I hope you are doing well. I invite you to visit my village during the summer holidays. We can explore the mango orchards and play traditional games like Gilli Danda with the local boys. It will be a refreshing change from the busy city life. Your loving friend, Amit.

questions.question_text: Write a short paragraph on the importance of choosing a profession or 'Vocation' that you truly love and enjoy doing. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Choosing a vocation that you truly love is essential for a happy and fulfilling life. When you enjoy your work, it does not feel like a heavy burden. Passion drives you to learn more, overcome challenges easily, and achieve great success. Doing what brings you joy ultimately leads to lasting personal satisfaction.
